name: Sketch
description: Two passes of the same box, the second not quite over the first.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M14 10 H86 V84 H14 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M14 10 H86 V84 H14 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 16 H92 V90 H18 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 16 H92 V90 H18 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }); opacity: 0.75; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
